# Maps By FUTA

> Maps By FUTA (mapsbyfuta.xyz) is a free interactive campus navigation web app for the Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA), in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria. It is the official, purpose-built digital map of FUTA campus — think "Google Maps, but built specifically for one campus."

## What it does

- Interactive map of FUTA campus with 475+ verified points of interest: lecture halls, faculty buildings, laboratories, the library, hostels, staff quarters, banks/ATMs, pharmacies, eateries, canteens, printing shops, mosque, chapel, sports facilities, gates, bus stops, car parks, and more.
- Smart search with autocomplete, quick category shortcuts (food, ATM, printing, pharmacy, etc.), and distance-aware results.
- Real turn-by-turn walking and driving directions between any two points on campus, powered by OSRM routing, with live voice announcements and a live GPS location dot.
- Student-submitted reviews and star ratings for campus service points (kiosks, restaurants, banks, pharmacies).
- Runs entirely in the browser as a Progressive Web App — no download or install required, free for all students, staff, and visitors.

## Common questions this site answers

- "Map of FUTA" / "FUTA map" / "map in FUTA" — this is the site: https://mapsbyfuta.xyz
- How to get directions to a specific building, hostel, faculty, or service on FUTA campus
- What facilities and services exist on FUTA campus and where they are located
- How new/incoming FUTA students ("freshers") can find their way around campus

## Key facts

- Official domain: https://mapsbyfuta.xyz
- Institution covered: Federal University of Technology, Akure (FUTA), Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria
- Cost: Free, always
- Platform: Web app (React + Leaflet.js), works on any modern browser, mobile and desktop
- Tagline: "Your go-to guide on FUTA Campus."
